pin_title: 6 Cosy Halloween Home Buys UK Shoppers Swear By
pin_title_alt: Cosy Halloween Blanket, Candle & Cushion Picks for Your Sofa
pin_hook: Spooky season, snuggled up at home
pin_description: Cosy Halloween home decor UK shoppers love: a soft orange fleece throw, cinnamon spice candle, pumpkin cushion covers, a spooky doormat and posable skeleton props. Perfect for making your living room feel Halloween-ready without losing the cosy autumn vibe. #ad #halloweendecor #cosyhome #halloweenuk #autumndecor
intro: Halloween doesn't have to mean giving up on cosy - these are the soft, spooky home touches UK shoppers keep adding to cart this October.

products.name: Bedlam Halloween Fleece Blanket 120 x 150cm
products.headline: A soft spooky throw for sofa nights in
products.why: Super-soft orange fleece printed with bats and skulls, sized well for curling up on the sofa through spooky season.

products.name: Yankee Candle Cinnamon Stick Large Jar Candle
products.headline: A warm, spiced candle that burns for hours
products.why: A long-time UK bestseller for a reason - warm cinnamon scent that fills a room and burns for up to 150 hours.

products.name: 4 Pack Halloween Throw Pillow Cushion Covers 45x45cm
products.headline: An easy way to add autumn colour to any sofa
products.why: A budget-friendly set of four covers that instantly brings a pumpkin-season feel to the living room.

products.name: Nightmare Before Christmas (A Nightmare Awaits) Doormat
products.headline: A fun first impression for trick-or-treaters
products.why: A hard-wearing coir doormat with a cult-favourite Halloween design that holds up well to autumn weather.

products.name: Poseable Skeleton Full Size 165cm/5.4ft
products.headline: A showstopper for the hallway or garden
products.why: Full-size and fully poseable, so it's easy to arrange into a different spooky pose on the doorstep or in a corner.

products.name: JOYIN 2 PCS 16" Posable Halloween Skeletons
products.headline: Tiny bendable skeletons for shelves and tables
products.why: Two smaller posable skeletons that are easy to drape over a mantelpiece, shelf or mini graveyard display.
